properties.evidence: That repair's own text: "THE SET IS THE PAIRS WITH EVIDENCE, NOT EVERY PAIR THAT COULD BE ARGUED FOR. Requirement↔Component is plausibly a layer pair and is deliberately absent — nobody has measured it." PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS in capture.rs (read 2026-09-16) holds ten pairs and none of Capability↔Component, Requirement↔Component, Component↔Component or Capability↔DesignRule. The xrt-demo genesis supplies the measurement the repair said it was waiting for: 7 refusals on those pairs, 7 judged distinct with distinct_from, 0 duplicates; bhome's 2026-08-31 count was 12/0 on other pairs. The repair worked as designed and its stated reopening condition has now been met.
